name: m5-erasure-one-pass
description: Does [retronym/scala#256](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/256) (`5d9a21f594`, erasure in one traversal without retyping with a `Typer`) make compiles faster? The PR and its parent `632df4153c` are loaded with `@build=` in class loaders of their own and alternate iteration by iteration in each fork; `aa` is the parent again, an A/A for the pairing's noise. Whole compile of the scala corpus (`jdkHome=25.0.4-tem`), 3 forks. m5-pro, patched JDK 26, 8G heap with a fixed 3G young generation and `-XX:hashCode=3`, a 1G code cache without flushing. Both builds compiled with the release optimizer settings (`-opt:l:inline -opt-inline-from:scala/**`).

variantDescriptions.aa: `base` again, in a third class loader
